title: Horton Winter 2019 Table 3: Exploration, Canal, Inventor, Engineer, Lackeys

sources.author: Adam Horton
sources.note: Winter 2019 Tournament Summary; Table 3, designed, played in the Swiss rounds

quality_note: Designer gives a concrete, playtested build that empties Provinces by turn 12; the champion built a variant and took six Provinces in one turn.
